For example, the heart is unaffected by an electric shock through the brain, such as may be used to treat manic depression. And it is a general truth that the longer the duration of a shock, the greater its effects. <link target-id="import-auto-id3190768"/> presents a graph that illustrates the effects of frequency on a shock.
